cases.prompt: Research the available approaches, clarify the trade-offs with me, then plan and implement our multi-module reporting feature.
cases.reason: Substantial research-to-delivery workflow.

cases.prompt: Use SureForge to correct this typo: teh report.
cases.reason: Explicit invocation activates the skill but does not justify full ceremony.

cases.prompt: Use SureForge in full mode to audit this one-paragraph policy before I approve it.
cases.reason: Explicit full mode overrides the light default, subject to available checks and permissions.

cases.prompt: Prepare a migration plan for a production service, including permissions, rollback, verification, and review before execution.
cases.reason: A production migration plan warrants high assurance because an incorrect plan can later cause consequential changes. Planning-only authorization still forbids execution.

cases.prompt: Review every page in this 80-page PDF, fix the layout issues, and verify the final file before delivery.
cases.reason: Explicit extensive visual assurance and full coverage.

cases.prompt: Compare three vendors using current evidence and our budget, ask about missing requirements, and write a decision study.
cases.reason: Decision research with material ambiguity and trade-offs.

cases.prompt: Build this feature across the API, database, and client. Check edge cases, use an independent review if authorized, and show what was tested.
cases.reason: Multi-file deliverable with explicit verification and review.

cases.prompt: Produce an EPUB and check every content section in the two readers and font sizes we agree on.
cases.reason: Extensive complete content/rendering assurance.

cases.prompt: Resume the interrupted standard-tier delivery audit. The bounded, reversible scope has not changed, but the output changed after review; establish what evidence still applies before continuing.
cases.reason: The prompt explicitly preserves the previous standard tier and bounded scope; evidence applicability still needs checking.

cases.prompt: Develop a full implementation plan from this vague product brief, research alternatives, and resolve important unknowns before coding.
cases.reason: Research-first clarification and planning; do not code without authority.
